calls.statement:
SELECT o.fulfilment_type, rs.store_id AS return_store, count(*) n, count(DISTINCT r.return_line_id) nd, sum(r.refund_net) refund, min(r.return_date), max(r.return_date)
FROM fact_return_line r
JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.sales_line_id=r.sales_line_id
JOIN dim_store ss ON ss.store_key=f.store_key
JOIN dim_store rs ON rs.store_key=r.store_key
LEFT JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
WHERE (ss.store_id=900 OR rs.store_id=900) AND r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-12-22' AND DATE '2026-02-22'
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY ALL
SELECT count(*) n, count(DISTINCT return_line_id) ids, count(DISTINCT sales_line_id) sl FROM fact_return_line WHERE return_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-12-22' AND DATE '2026-02-22'

WITH sales AS (
  SELECT CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', o.dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS business_date,
         o.fulfilment_type, f.net_amount AS net
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
  JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id = f.receipt_id AND o.status IN ('delivered','collected')
  WHERE s.store_id = 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
rets AS (
  SELECT r.return_date AS business_date, o.fulfilment_type, -r.refund_net AS net
  FROM fact_return_line r
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
  JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.sales_line_id = r.sales_line_id
  LEFT JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
  WHERE s.store_id = 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
u AS (SELECT * FROM sales UNION ALL SELECT * FROM rets)
SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period,
  ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN fulfilment_type='click_and_collect' THEN net ELSE 0 END),2) cc_net,
  ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN fulfilment_type IS NULL THEN net ELSE 0 END),2) unclassified,
  ROUND(SUM(net),2) web_net,
  ROUND(100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN fulfilment_type='click_and_collect' THEN net ELSE 0 END)/SUM(net),2) share_pct
FROM u JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=u.business_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period IN (9,10)
GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

WITH sales AS (
  SELECT CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', o.dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS business_date, f.net_amount AS net
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
  JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id = f.receipt_id AND o.status IN ('delivered','collected')
  WHERE s.store_id = 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
), rets AS (
  SELECT r.return_date AS business_date, -r.refund_net AS net
  FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
  WHERE s.store_id = 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
), u AS (SELECT * FROM sales UNION ALL SELECT * FROM rets)
SELECT d.fiscal_period, ROUND(SUM(net),2) web_net_900 FROM u JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=u.business_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period IN (9,10) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT d.fiscal_period, ROUND(SUM(net_sales),2) rpt_net, ROUND(SUM(net_sales_before_returns),2) rpt_before, ROUND(SUM(returns_net),2) rpt_ret
FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=r.business_date
WHERE r.store_id=900 AND d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period IN (9,10) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH sales AS (
  SELECT CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', o.dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS business_date, o.fulfilment_type, f.net_amount AS net
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
  JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id = f.receipt_id AND o.status IN ('delivered','collected')
  WHERE s.store_id = 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
), rets AS (
  SELECT r.return_date AS business_date, o.fulfilment_type, -r.refund_net AS net
  FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
  JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.sales_line_id = r.sales_line_id JOIN dim_store ss ON ss.store_key=f.store_key
  JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
  WHERE ss.store_id = 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
), u AS (SELECT *, 'S' k FROM sales UNION ALL SELECT *, 'R' FROM rets)
SELECT d.fiscal_period,
 ROUND(100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN fulfilment_type='click_and_collect' AND k='S' THEN net ELSE 0 END)/SUM(CASE WHEN k='S' THEN net END),2) before_returns_pct,
 ROUND(100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN fulfilment_type='click_and_collect' THEN net ELSE 0 END)/SUM(net),2) all_web_returns_pct
FROM u JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=u.business_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period IN (9,10) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
